executable.title: Image Coordinate Transforms (MIATT HW06)
executable.description: Practice the four ITK coordinate transform methods on a 3D medical image: TransformIndexToPhysicalPoint, TransformPhysicalPointToIndex, TransformPhysicalPointToContinuousIndex, and TransformContinuousIndexToPhysicalPoint.

parameters.label: Physical Point
parameters.description: A point in physical (world) space in mm to transform into index space.

double.name: physX
double.label: Physical X (mm)
double.description: X component of the input physical point (mm).

double.name: physY
double.label: Physical Y (mm)
double.description: Y component of the input physical point (mm).

double.name: physZ
double.label: Physical Z (mm)
double.description: Z component of the input physical point (mm).

parameters.label: Integer Index
parameters.description: A voxel address in integer index space to transform into physical space.

integer.name: indexI
integer.label: Index I
integer.description: I component of the integer voxel index.

integer.name: indexJ
integer.label: Index J
integer.description: J component of the integer voxel index.

integer.name: indexK
integer.label: Index K
integer.description: K component of the integer voxel index.
